levels.surface: محمد، بن عبد الله بن نمير

notes: Three taḥwīl branches meet at «كلهم عن عبيد الله بن عمر»: the four names after it are the shared tail.
«أبي» (occurrence 2) is the father of محمد، بن عبد الله بن نمير, a bare relation; occurrence 1 is inside «أبي شيبة».
The wording «بمثله» is left out; the Prophet is the end of the chain.
